description: A captivating combination of hilltop breezes & stunning ocean views at this cozy home near Sandy Beach. Private above ground pool & two levels of indoor & outdoor space for you to enjoy! A perfect setting for those that wish to share time together at home or those who are looking to venture out & explore a variety of nearby restaurants and attractions! Located just off the 413, which truly is the road to happiness!The spaceEscape to comfort and coastal vibes in this beautifully updated home near Km 4.7 on the iconic Road to Happiness (Route 413). Perfect for couples or groups of up to 8 guests, this spacious retreat offers the perfect blend of modern amenities and laid-back charm, ideal for making unforgettable memories in paradise.Inside, enjoy all-new mattresses, ac units, fans, refreshed decor, and upgraded comforts throughout. Each bedroom and living area is equipped with AC and ceiling fans, giving you the flexibility to sleep in breezy, open-window bliss or crisp, cool comfort.Step outside to the expansive two-story wooden deck and above ground pool, all surrounded by solar lighting that creates a seamless day-to-night experience…the space is made for lingering.The home is thoughtfully stocked with bath and beach towels, beach chairs, a portable cooler….everything you need for both adventure and relaxation. Downstairs, you’ll find a convenient unfinished laundry and storage area, perfect for stashing boards and beach gear after a day of surfing.With two separate levels of indoor and outdoor living space, there’s plenty of room for everyone to spread out, unwind, and recharge—whether you’re sipping coffee on the deck, taking a nap in the shade, or gathered together for dinner and stargazing.Guest accessGuests will have access to the entire property and nobody else will be staying in the house! There is an option to rent the main level and the studio level of the house separately. Let us know your group size and we will help you make your decision and be sure that you’re booking through the correct listing!Other things to noteDepending on the length of your stay and your arrival time, you may find it inconvenient to make it to the grocery store on the day of your arrival. Whenever possible I try to offer grocery service where I pick up some important items for you whether it be bottled water, breakfast items, alcohol, snacks, etc. Please be careful to read the instructions I have provided regarding how to locate the house and how to enter the house. These are the two most common questions that I get from Guests arriving at the house as guests tend to overlook. We don’t have physical addresses here in Puerto Rico so you must rely on the GPS location that I provide!

description: Casa Dos Hermanas is a peaceful getaway situated just a walk away from the popular Pools and Sandy Beaches and a quick drive to Maria's, Domes and Rincon town center. Enjoy a coffee and the Boricuan sunrise from the roofdeck before surfing one of the many world class breaks or spend your day relaxing by the pool. There is a 3 bedroom main house that will be all yours and a 1 bedroom apartment the owners live in at times. During Covid no parties. Price dependant on number of people staying.The space***The home is beautiful as is but we will be updating and redecorating between guests in the coming year***The open floor plan kitchen and dining room make it an ideal place to entertain and send time together while the air conditioned rooms are comfortable and quiet so you can get some rest. We have cable, wifi and a multitude of board games available depending on what mood you're in. As wonderful as the house is, it is the back patio and roof deck that tend to be the biggest draw. The pool deck offers ample lounge chairs to soak up the sun while listening to tropical birdsong and the sound of the pool's waterfall. If you're more into the sunset than the sunrise, you can also enjoy the sun's last dance from the second story roof deck before heading out for dinner. For the days and nights you're not sampling a local eatery, the back patio is a great place to grill some local fish or veggies and gather around the table to rehash the day. Depending on the season, most of the trees on the property provide fruit- from the multiple avocado, banana and bananas to our more rare piña mango, papaya and guanabana- that you are welcome to add to your meal. Casa Dos Hermanas offers plenty of parking, a rarity in the area. We also have a 275W generator and 2,000 gallon water tank so you will have continue to have power and water when the reality of being on a tropical island can come knocking.COVID-19 Limitations - we are spacing rentals by 2 days to allow for thorough disinfecting and cleaning, No more than 8 people are allowed at the house at any time as we cannot risk any illegal large gatherings at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience but are doing the best we can to ensure everyone's safety and limit the spread of the virus.Guest accessYou will have access to the whole main house and exterior property. The attached apartment is my private residence. The apartment and the main house share a roof but no walls, there is a walkway between to two structuresOther things to noteOwner lives on property with 2 dogs. We stay to our side of the house and give renters the pool/patio/BBQ during your stay.

description: Casa Bomberos is a spacious home with an incredible saltwater pool, located just minutes from everything Rincón has to offer. Enjoy both privacy and proximity to beaches, restaurants, and downtown attractions. The property features two separate units with six bedrooms total - four bedrooms upstairs and 2 bedrooms down. Generous common areas and balconies on both levels make it ideal for extended families or groups of friends traveling together. @casabomberosThe spaceThe house features two stories with ample outside deck space to eat, sip your morning coffee and relax. The first floor has a well equipped bar to host from poolside, and the second floor deck features a large outside dining table for dinner al fresco while you watch the sunset.The house is located conveniently just a short drive to nearby beaches, restaurants, etc. You'll be minutes away from everything you need in Puntas and greater Rincon beyond. The units are entirely separate from one another, and join outside on the pool deck. Private entrances for each. The surrounding yard is lush and green and fruit trees abound! Pick an avocado for yourself while you breathe in the incredible scent of the ylang ylang flowers growing right off the back porch. Bananas, mangos, papaya and Caribbean cranberries can all be found in season - to name a few!Guest accessThe whole house is yours!Other things to noteWe want to enjoy your stay here in beautiful Rincon, Puerto Rico. - it's truly a special place to visit. It is important to remember, however, that there are neighbors who live here year-round who deserve the utmost level of respect when it comes to noise pollution. Quiet Hours are in effect, according to local municipalities and government, from 10pm - 7am, 7 days a week. The property is equipped with a generator in the event of power outages, as well as ample propane supplying a large outdoor grill and over 2000 gallons of solar-heated water in on-site cisterns. The power and water utility systems are fragile and are often interrupted throughout the island of Puerto Rico. When booking this listing (or anywhere on the island of Puerto Rico) you acknowledge these occurrences are somewhat common and out of our control. Conserving power and water, especially while the generator is running or when town water systems are shut off, will help to ensure you have a comfortable stay. For example, 2000 gallons of water can support conservative usage (fast showers, strategic dishwashing) for 12 guests for roughly 2-3 days.We thank you in advance for your consideration and care of our incredible home and the surrounding neighborhood!!

description: Welcome to your private, romantic hideaway tucked in the lush of Rincon/Anasco. BRISAS SUITE is designed for couples seeking place, privacy, and unforgettable moments.Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply need a break from the world, our heated private pool, breathtaking sunsets, and total privacy make BRISAS SUITE the perfect escape.The space💖What You’ll Love:• Your very own heated private pool — no sharing, just pure relaxation• Total seclusion & privacy — no neighbors in sight• Breathtaking ocean views and unforgettable sunsets, even from your pool• Plush king bed with cozy, high-quality linens for restful nights• Fully equipped kitchenette perfect for romantic meals or your favorite snacks• Peaceful, quiet surroundings immersed in lush nature• Reliable comfort with our backup power generator and water cistern — no worries about outages during your stay• Private entrance and free parking — hassle-free and convenient• Easy self check-in with smart lock for a smooth arrival• Friendly support in English and Spanish, with a host who truly cares• Just 15 minutes from beautiful beaches and local attractions, yet tucked away in nature’s embrace• Ideal for honeymoons, proposals, anniversaries, or a serene getaway from it all• Pet Friendly! Bring your well-behaved furry companions — we love hosting pets who are part of the family!🛏️Your suite:• 1 Bedroom with air conditioning for your comfort• Kitchenette with stovetop, mini fridge, coffee maker, and utensils• Modern private bathroom with hot water• High-speed Wi-Fi to stay connected• Private terrace with cozy outdoor seating• Smart TV with ambient lighting for the perfect atmosphere• Special Extras — Available Upon Request (additional fees apply)• Floating heart tray in the pool, beautifully arranged with your favorite charcuterie• Relaxing couples or individual massages in a peaceful, private setting• Romantic decorations for anniversaries, birthdays, or special moments• Fresh flowers, artisanal charcuterie, chocolate-covered strawberries• Helium balloons, custom cakes for any occasion• Marriage proposal setups — we’ll help you create unforgettable memories• We’re here to make your stay truly magical.🛬Prime and Accessible Location:Our hotel is perfectly nestled between Rincón and Añasco in a serene, exclusive area with jaw-dropping views. Although it’s about 2.5 hours from Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport in San Juan, we’re just a 30-minute drive from Rafael Hernández International Airport in Aguadilla and only an hour from Mercedita International Airport in Ponce—giving you flexible travel options.The journey to the hotel is an experience in itself, taking you through charming towns and stunning landscapes that showcase the true spirit of Puerto Rico. The roads are well-maintained, turning your drive into a scenic adventure and your first taste of Puerto Rican magic.🏞️Immersed in NatureAs we’re located in a beautiful rural mountain setting, it’s possible you may spot local wildlife such as birds, lizards, or even the occasional coquí (tree frog). Depending on the season, bugs may also appear — a natural part of staying so close to nature. We do our best to manage this, but it's part of the charm of being truly away from the city and surrounded by the outdoors.🚘Transportation Recommendation:Please note that Uber is not available at our location. While some taxi or transportation services may be available, they tend to be expensive. For maximum freedom and to truly enjoy the area, we highly recommend renting a car. This way, you can explore comfortably and at your own pace.Come for the views, stay for the peace, and leave with beautiful memories — and maybe a new furry friend!😎Nearby Beaches & AttractionsDiscover the Best of Puerto Rico's West CoastFrom our serene retreat, you're perfectly positioned to explore some of the island's most stunning beaches and vibrant attractions. Here's what awaits you:🏖️ Top Beaches• Domes Beach (Rincón) – Just 15 minutes away, this beach is renowned for its excellent surfing conditions and picturesque sunsets.• Sandy Beach (Rincón) – Also a 15-minute drive, offering golden sands and a lively atmosphere, perfect for swimming and beachside dining.• Buyé Beach (Cabo Rojo) – Approximately 45 hour minutes away, known for its calm, clear waters and family-friendly environment.• Playa Sucia (Cabo Rojo) – About 1 hour and 10 minutes away, this secluded beach boasts dramatic cliffs and turquoise waters, ideal for nature lovers.• Crash Boat Beach (Aguadilla) – A 30-minute drive takes you to this popular spot, famous for its vibrant marine life and excellent snorkeling opportunities.• Jobos Beach (Isabela) – Located 45 minutes away, this beach is a favorite among surfers and offers a relaxed, local vibe.• La Parguera (Lajas) – Approximately 1 hour away, this area features a unique bioluminescent bay where you can swim among glowing organisms—a truly magical experience. 🎨 Cultural & Adventure Activities• Rincón Art Walk – Every Thursday evening (5:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.), downtown Rincón transforms into a vibrant art scene with local artists, live music, and food vendors.• Las Cascadas Water Park (Aguadilla) – Just 30 minutes away, enjoy the Caribbean's largest water park, featuring slides, wave pools, and fun for all ages.• Cabo Rojo National Wildlife Refuge – Explore this 1,836-acre subtropical dry forest, home to diverse wildlife and excellent birdwatching trails. • Joyuda (Cabo Rojo) – Known as the "Seafood Capital" of Puerto Rico, this area offers a variety of seaside restaurants serving fresh local catches. • La Parguera Bioluminescent Bay (Lajas) – Experience the only bioluminescent bay in Puerto Rico where swimming is permitted. Tours are available by boat or kayak, allowing you to immerse yourself in this natural wonder. We’re happy to share local tips and recommendations to help you make the most of your stay. From scenic beaches to local dining and hidden gems, we’ll point you in the right direction so you can plan your own unforgettable adventure.Please take a moment to review our house rules to ensure a pleasant and comfortable stay for all guests.Ready to escape?Your private paradise is waiting. Breathtaking views, total privacy, and unforgettable moments — all that’s missing is you.Book now and make the magic yours.Guest accessYou’ll have full and private access to your suite, pool, terrace, kitchenette, bathroom, and private parking. No shared spaces — everything is just for you.• For security reasons, the location pins with the exact address will be shared on the day of check-in at 11:00 a.m. Please avoid using the address provided by the app, as it may not be accurate and could lead you through very narrow roads. Follow the recommended route, and we’ll send it through the Airbnb chat.Other things to notePlease keep in mind that THE VIEW LUXE HOTEL is located in a beautiful mountain area surrounded by lush nature, offering breathtaking views. Due to this natural setting, it’s common to encounter harmless insects such as flies, ladybugs, spiders, mosquitoes, and lizards. We professionally spray regularly to minimize their presence, but complete elimination is challenging in this environment.During the rainy season (June to October), we recommend keeping your suite doors closed to prevent mosquitoes from entering. We provide insect spray for your convenience.We’re a pet-friendly hotel! For details about our pet policy, please refer to our house rules.Thank you for understanding and helping us maintain a wonderful natural experience for all our guests.
